notes.title: 【Version 1.1】 Content Update
notes.notes:
Some time has passed since Desk Paws launched—how is your game progress going? How many little pets have you collected?

In this update, we are thrilled to announce that 10 adorable and wondrous new pets have arrived in Desk Paws, along with their many offspring pets! We welcome everyone to return to Desk Paws and enjoy a fresh encounter with them ♥



New Content

Added a Pet Gift Box in the store. When purchased, you'll receive one randomly selected base-level pet from the newly added ones.

The claw machine has been updated with new pets.

Now, pets in your backpack display a label: “Unclaimed final form reward token” if they haven’t yet earned their final-stage reward token.

notes.title: 【Version 1.0.6】 Minor Patch Update
notes.notes:
In this update, we’ve once again addressed and optimized several key issues players care about. Details are as follows:

Fixes

Now, tokens will not be moved into the fridge before completing the initial tutorial.

Fixed an issue where volume would reset after turning off Do Not Disturb.

Fixed an issue where recalling a downstairs pet via right-click in the inventory would not correctly decrement the downstairs pet count.

Optimizations

Many players reported that placing too many pets on the desktop while having auto-feeding and cloud auto-production enabled would repeatedly trigger eating sounds, and when too many feeding animations run simultaneously, pets could get stuck.
Therefore, you can now disable feeding animations from Settings! This is super helpful for long idle sessions!

New Content

When it rains, two new small umbrellas will appear!

notes.title: 【Version 1.0.5】 Minor Patch Update
notes.notes:
In this update, we have once again implemented fixes and optimizations for some of the issues that players care about most. The details are as follows:


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the white noise loop playback would occasionally fail.

Fixed an issue that broke the weather feature.

Fixed an issue where the actual duration of "Storm Day" did not match the displayed duration.

Fixed an issue where, in certain circumstances, a downstairs room would show "Room Full" even if no pets were present.

Fixed an issue where the scroll page button in some UI elements would not respond to clicks.

Fixed an issue where, in certain circumstances, pets would get "stuck in place and turn around repeatedly."


Optimizations

Adjusted the positions of some UI elements on displays with non-standard resolutions.

Now, the fridge will no longer move along with the house and can be freely dragged.

Now, Do Not Disturb mode no longer affects the white noise volume.


New Content

Two weeks have passed since the game's release! Have you purchased many luxury homes? If so, then settle into those luxury homes and search together for ✨shooting stars✨!

*Added a special event and a special reward.

notes.title: 【Version 1.0.4】Small Patch Update
notes.notes:
In this update, we have once again addressed some of the issues of most concern to players with various fixes and optimizations. The details are as follows:

Fixes:

Fixed an issue where enabling "Do Not Disturb" would cause the mute function to stop working.

Fixed an issue where purchasing the "Little Cloud" upgrade had no effect in certain cases.

Fixed an issue where in some cases it was impossible to lock the frame rate to "30 FPS".

Fixed a sprite error in pet movement.

Fixed an issue where, in specific houses, visitors would sit in the wrong location.

Re-verified certain Steam achievements to ensure they correctly register as completed.

Items in the refrigerator can now be dragged out directly!

New Features & Optimizations:

Tokens can now be "frozen" in the fridge... though they do get a bit icy.

Added a new item in the store that can change all blueprint prices to "+4".

Appropriately enlarged the "exit" of the claw machine.

notes.title: [Version 1.0.3] Minor Patch Update
notes.notes:
In this update, we’ve once again addressed and optimized several issues that players care most about. The specific changes are as follows:

Fixes:

Fixed an issue where pets with breeding guide numbers 1104, 1111, 1115, and 1151 could not be properly incubated.

Fixed an issue where the "Hatch Accelerator" effect continued to play even after "Do Not Disturb" was enabled.

Fixed an issue where a player who pinned the game to the taskbar and opened it from there would lose their saved game.

Fixed an issue where the purchase of "Lively Cloud" might not work under certain circumstances.

Returned a pet that mistakenly appeared in the breeding guide back to the breeding guide.

Fixed display issues with "Lunafi’s Great Adventure" under certain screen resolutions.

Fixed an issue where the window pinning buttons were displayed incorrectly.

Fixed an issue where the window pinning buttons were displayed incorrectly.

New Features:

A new button has been added in the "Settings" that allows you to toggle whether large amounts of coins and hearts are shown! Turning it off will stop the display of large quantities of coins.

A new item has been added to the shop: Storm Day! This allows you to start the rain regardless of conditions and lasts for 2 hours!

A new item has been added to the shop: Big Plate.

Lunafi’s adventure world has been revamped! You can now freely drag the game window position!

Regarding the save file issue, a special thanks to players Racks Lee, Moo, Laura A. G.G., and 未闻 for their help!

notes.title: 【Version 1.0.2】Minor Patch Update
notes.notes:
In this update, we’ve once again addressed and optimized several issues that players care most about. The specific changes are as follows:

The “Bottommost” button in the Settings page has been expanded into three options: “Topmost”, “Bottommost”, and “Not Topmost” (The game window can now behave like a regular window — neither pinned on top nor bottom).

A “Framerate Limit” slider has been added to the Settings page. When too many pets are placed on the desktop, performance may be affected. We recommend lowering the framerate accordingly.

A new option “Only Eat Pearls” has been added. When enabled, pets will only consume small pearls even if auto-feeding is turned on.

You can now right-click a pet in the inventory to send it back individually. This option is also available in the pet’s detailed info panel.

Recalling pets will no longer recall "eggs". Eggs will now correctly remain in the room.

Once you purchase any “Egg Incubator”, eggs will display a visual effect to indicate that the incubator is active.

Pets will no longer auto-consume food in the room, even if auto-feeding is enabled.

Special thanks to the player “XianLing” for updating the \[English] and \[Japanese] names of our pets!

notes.title: [Version 1.0.11]Minor Patch Update
notes.notes:
We apologize for the new issues that arose after the last update! We have fixed some of the problems and made some optimizations. The details of this update are as follows:

Fixed an issue where "buying room upgrades" failed under certain circumstances. After the update, the "lost" upgrades will be applied upon launching the game.

Now, when your desktop items are full, newly obtained items no longer return to "income void" but are directly added to \[Fridge] or \[Big Mouth Box] based on their type.

Fixed an issue where "auto-looping adventure" would sometimes fail. The logic for adventure rewards has been modified when "Do Not Disturb" or "Pomodoro" is active. Now, rewards are directly based on the duration of the Do Not Disturb mode.

Clearly, adding more ways to earn coins wasn't fair to players who enjoy "Pomodoro." Therefore, now after the Pomodoro ends, you will receive a large amount of "Tomatoes" as a reward!

Fixed an issue where after using "Do Not Disturb" in certain cases, the "Little Cloud" could not be clicked.

Fixed an issue where some room tokens could not be purchased in the store.

Fixed some discrepancies between pet illustrations and their in-game models.

Fixed a formatting error in the information card.

notes.title: [Version 1.0.1]Minor Patch Update
notes.notes:
After the game’s release, we received a lot of feedback from players; thank you all for your care and support! In this update, we prioritized fixing some of the most reported issues, as detailed below:
Adventures will now loop automatically.

Now you can purchase “Cloud Auto-Production” in the shop.

For players who prefer to earn rewards through their own efforts, we recommend purchasing the “Lunafi’s Great Adventure Ticket” from the shop. This ticket allows you to repeatedly gain coins and a small amount of materials!

We have once again fixed the claw machine’s claw; theoretically, pets will no longer “slip out” of the claw.

Fixed an issue for some players where their “Gacha Tokens” did not match the remaining gacha count in the gacha machine.

Fixed an issue where certain achievements’ timers were not syncing properly.

Sharkie Dragon can now be sent to GLO and put up for adoption.

Adjusted the prompt for sending to GLO in some languages to make it more understandable, along with some other localization fixes.

Fixed an issue where Mac and Windows save files could not synchronize properly.

Fixed an issue where some players would experience "save failure, repeatedly returning to a specific save point starting stage" under certain circumstances.

Note* This is an emergency patch, and we did not have enough time for full testing. As a result, there might be some minor issues! We will gradually improve it!

notes.title: 6/16 Temporary Update Patch
notes.notes:
We found that some pets' sizes and shapes may cause the "claw machine claw" to have difficulty hitting them, or they can only be grabbed more easily at specific angles. 
Therefore, we quickly modified the "grab size detection" for some pets. We hope that through this patch, players can have a better grabbing experience.

notes.title: Major Content Update for Demo Version
notes.notes:
This update resolves many issues and adds some improvements. We hope you’ll enjoy a more comfortable experience!

Here are the detailed patch notes:

New Features:

"GLO" has officially launched! You can find its advertisement in your backpack. It’s an agency where you can proactively offer your pets, and it will regularly grant you gold based on the total number of pets you’ve provided.

We've installed a refrigerator in the bottom-level room! It can store the food from your desktop, helping you avoid being overwhelmed by piles of food.

Added a [Keep Bottom] feature, allowing the game to stay at the bottom layer of your desktop—perfect if you don’t want [Do Not Disturb] mode but also don’t want the game window blocking other things!

Adjustments:
The claw machine now has a much lower chance of dropping dolls, reducing frustration in the early game!

Feeding is now more precise.

When dragging pets, their size now matches the house scale, making it harder to drag them into the wrong room.

When dragging food, if there’s a pet who likes that food, it will show a unique expression as a hint.

Dragging out a pet no longer automatically selects the first pet.

Some store items were removed, and some new ones were added. Go check the shop!

Added a [Disable Weather] button, and rain frequency has been reduced.

When [Full Do Not Disturb] is active, you can now drag from anywhere on the folder, instead of needing to grab the surrounding area.

The [Pomodoro Timer] can now be forcibly canceled.

Expanded the [Recall] button in the backpack—you can now precisely recall pets based on their location.

Added a growth bar for pets in the backpack and made some UI improvements.

Reworked the Growth system: fully fed babies now reward a token, and max-growth pets now sparkle instead of becoming huge.

Pet size now represents weight. Each pet has its own weight, and you can buy an item in the shop to reset it.

Clicking a pet will now drop a coin or building material.

Updated some food items: removed duplicate fruit types and added new foods.

Updated the UI layout for the [Settings Menu].

Changed the position of the [Exit Button].

UI now properly blocks mouse input—it will no longer "click through" to items behind it.

If the [Toolbar] or [House] goes offscreen, it will now return to the center after a few seconds.

When pressing buttons in a disabled area of the claw machine, a clearer alert is now shown.

The claw machine [Exit] now responds to tapping, helping resolve the issue of dolls piling up.

We! Changed! The back of the info card! It looks much better now!

Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where dolls could get stuck in the claw.

Fixed an issue where food could get stuck on the desktop and become unresponsive.

The position of the [Toolbar] is now saved and loaded properly.

The [Toolbar Volume] is now correctly saved and restored.

The startup music no longer plays when in mute mode.

Fixed many layer-order issues.

Fixed an issue where the [Hearts] count wouldn't update after purchasing items.

Fixed an issue where eggs remained on the desktop after enabling Do Not Disturb.

Fixed an issue where some bred pets didn't respond correctly to their favorite food.

Fixed an issue where some bred pets didn’t display adventure rewards properly.

Fixed an issue where the claw machine continued to play the "moving" sound.

Fixed an issue where backpack blueprints didn’t update required materials after use.

Fixed a bug allowing [Reward Mail] to be claimed multiple times.

Eggs now correctly scale with the house size after being born.
